title: PGC Reference Implementation: Protocol Runtime (protocol_runtime)
description:
Deterministic execution engine. Traverses a precompiled execution graph and produces traceable governed outcomes. Determines no new governed behavior at runtime; execution is a traversal of what the sealed snapshot already declares.

Part of the Protocol-Governed Computing reference corpus. Cite the version DOI of the release you used, not the concept DOI.
notes: Implements or supports the Open PGC Standard (10.5281/zenodo.22150616). Version is taken from the GitHub release tag; do not hard-code it here.
